//: Coverage floors for the backend suite, enforced by scripts/check-coverage-thresholds.mjs. Each value is set just under the level measured when coverage was introduced, so it fails on a regression and not on ordinary churn. A floor may only be raised; lowering one requires a reason in allowFloorDecrease, because that reason is what turns an exception into a decision a reviewer can see.
//scope: A key ending in `/` covers every file whose path contains it, aggregating covered and total counts rather than averaging percentages — an average would let one large well-covered file hide a small untouched one.
//routes: `functions` is omitted for src/routes/: the module exports arrow functions registered with the router, which are invoked by Express rather than by the suite, so the measurement is 0% and a floor there would assert nothing.
//seed: src/seed is exercised by the seeding CLI against a database rather than by the unit suite; its guard is covered directly (src/seed/__tests__) and the floor tracks the rest.
